newsitem.title: USA: Irata names new chairman, CFO.
newsitem.headline: Irata names new chairman, CFO.

text.p: Irata Inc said on Wednesday it named Lance Wimmer chairman, president and chief executive officer and John Stuecheli as vice president and chief financial officer, as part of the company's restructuring.
Robert Searles Jr, the former president and chief executive officer, would remain at Irata as executive vice president and would continue as director, the company said.

Wimmer's firm, Wimmer Associates Inc, had been an advisor to Irata on its comprehensive restructuring since April 1996. Wimmer is the former president and chief operating officer of Swift Independent Corp, a food and distribution company.
The past eight years of Wimmer's career have focused on turnarounds, the company said.
Stuecheli was affiliated with Wimmer Associates Inc and had also helped Wimmer with the Irata restructuring since April 1996, the company said.
